entities.name: St. Patrick's Basilica, Ottawa
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Basilica of Saint Patrick is a Roman Catholic Church in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Located at 281 Nepean Street in Downtown Ottawa, it is the oldest church in the city that serves the English-speaking community. The Basilica is one of the regular buildings featured in the Doors Open Ottawa architectural heritage day.
